verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents step-by-step traces that capture model calls, retrieval, tool use and custom logic, with spans created through auto-instrumentation or manual `@tracer.chain` and `@tracer.tool` decorators. It also documents a Sessions feature that groups related traces into conversations and user sessions, with a tutorial for multi-turn tracking, and a community user confirms using its traces and spans. Missing for 10: an explicit description of the parent/child span hierarchy for nested agent steps, and hands-on corroboration of session grouping for multi-step agent runs specifically.
